Variable.doc:
Configuration table for ClaudeTasks

Keys:
 * width - Window width (default 420)
 * height - Window height (default 580)
 * margin - Window margin from screen edge (default 20)
 * refreshDebounce - Debounce time for file watcher (default 0.2)
 * debugMode - Enable debug logging (default false)
 * taskListId - Claude Code session ID (from CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID env var)
 * claudePath - Path to claude CLI (auto-discovered if nil)
 * terminalApp - Path to terminal app (auto-discovered if nil)
 * shell - Shell to use (defaults to $SHELL or /bin/zsh)
Variable.name: config

desc: Claude Code task viewer for Hammerspoon
doc:
Claude Code task viewer for Hammerspoon

Displays tasks from ~/.claude/tasks/ in a floating WebView window.
Features session management, quick task updates, and Claude CLI integration.

Download: https://github.com/jongwony/ClaudeTasks.spoon
